newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains down, pressured by stg.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains down, pressured by stg.

text.p: LIFFE grains moved lower in meagre trade, pressured by a firm sterling.
But sellers had deserted the wheat market at its lows and prices came off the bottom in later trade, traders said. "Nobody wanted to sell at the lows," one trader said.
Active November wheat last traded 0.15 stg lower at 84.50 stg, compared with a low of 84.10 stg. November volume was 127 of 287 lots done in total, making it by far the most traded contract.
Barley was well supported throughout the day, the trader said. Active November barley last traded unchanged at 79.55 stg on volume of 55 lots of the barley total of 87 lots.
The market was waiting for more harvest information before it could find new direction, he said.
